referred to as HAVEN1, titled “A randomized, multicenter, open-label, phase III clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of prophylactic emicizumab versus no prophylaxis in hemophilia A patients with inhibitors”

design.text: Randomized, multicenter, open-label Phase 3 study comparing prophylactic emicizumab (Arm A) versus no prophylaxis (Arm B) at a 2:1 randomization ratio, with two additional nonrandomized arms.

citations.quote: is a randomized, multicenter, open label, phase III clinical study which enrolled patients aged 12 years or older with hemophilia A who have inhibitors against FVIII. A total of 53 patients with inhibitors who received episodic treatment with bypassing agents prior to study entry were enrolled at a 2:1 randomization ratio to receive either prophylactic emicizumab (Arm A) or no prophylaxis (Arm B).

population.text: Adult and adolescent patients (≥12 years old) with hemophilia A with FVIII inhibitors who received episodic treatment with bypassing agents prior to study entry.

endpoint.text: Number of treated bleeds over the efficacy period (Arm A emicizumab prophylaxis vs. Arm B no prophylaxis).

citations.quote: The primary efficacy endpoint is the number of treated bleeds over the efficacy period.

n.text: 53 randomized (Arm A N=35; Arm B N=18); plus non-randomized Arm C N=49 and Arm D N=7.

result.text: Model-based ABR 2.9 (95% CI 1.7, 5.0) with emicizumab vs. 23.3 (12.3, 43.9) with no prophylaxis; ABR ratio 0.13 (95% CI 0.057, 0.277), p<0.0001 — an 87% reduction in treated bleeds.

indication.text: HEMLIBRA is indicated for routine prophylaxis to prevent or reduce the frequency of bleeding episodes in adult and pediatric patients with hemophilia A (congenital factor VIII deficiency) with factor VIII inhibitors.

citations.quote: HEMLIBRA is indicated for routine prophylaxis to prevent or reduce the frequency of bleeding episodes in adult and pediatric patients with hemophilia A (congenital factor VIII deficiency) with factor VIII inhibitors.

target_moa.text: Emicizumab is a humanized monoclonal modified IgG4 bispecific antibody that bridges activated factor IX (FIXa) and factor X to restore the function of missing activated factor VIII needed for effective hemostasis, functioning even in the presence of FVIII inhibitors.

citations.quote: Emicizumab is a humanized monoclonal modified immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) antibody with a bispecific antibody structure. Emicizumab bridges activated factor IX (FIXa) and FX to restore the function of missing activated FVIII that is needed for effective hemostasis.
Emicizumab has a novel mechanism of action that mimics the action of FVIII but can function even in the presence of FVIII inhibitors.
Humanized monoclonal modified immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) antibody with a bispecific antibody structure binding factor IXa and factor X

summary.text: HEMLIBRA (emicizumab-kxwh) received a Priority review as an original BLA. It was granted orphan designation for hemophilia A (1/10/2014) and breakthrough therapy designation (9/2/2015) for patients with hemophilia A with FVIII inhibitors. Full (not accelerated) approval was based on the reduction in annualized bleeding rate demonstrated in Study HAVEN1.
